response.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(CAST(li.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(li.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(li.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;
